steps.why: Load the validated PR-001 model as a live endpoint for real-time predictions
Freeze score and input distributions to establish a reference for drift detection
Arm PSI, CSI, latency, no-decision and A/E rules to monitor performance and data quality

data.rationale: Deploying the model ensures it is available for the traffic simulator, while baseline freezing provides a stable benchmark for detecting drift. The alert rules enable proactive monitoring of key performance indicators and data integrity, safeguarding model reliability.
